say: In 1964, two men shook hands on a deal worth five hundred dollars each. Sixty years later, that handshake is a company worth more than a hundred billion.
This is the entire history of Nike.
Chapter one. A runner and his coach.
Phil Knight was a middle distance runner at the University of Oregon. His coach, Bill Bowerman, was obsessed with making shoes lighter.

v.title: Phil Knight & Bill Bowerman
v.caption: Runner and coach, both obsessed with speed

say: Knight's plan was simple. Import cheap, high quality running shoes from Japan, and sell them out of the trunk of his car.

v.title: Knight's plan
items: Out of the trunk of his car

say: As Knight later put it, the cowards never started, and the weak died along the way.

v.text: The cowards never started and the weak died along the way.
